sec: MEN1 organ details: parathyroid, pancreas, pituitary and MEN2A gene · p859

items.q: Match MEN1 vs sporadic primary hyperparathyroidism — 1) MEN1 cause  2) Sporadic cause  3) MEN1 age  4) Sporadic age … A) Females >40 yrs (peak 60)  B) Asymmetric hyperplasia  C) <20 yrs  D) Adenoma
items.exp: MEN1: asymmetric hyperplasia, <20 yrs, M=F; sporadic: adenoma, females >40 (peak 60), F>>>M. (Book p859)

items.q: The IOC for localising hyperparathyroidism (both MEN1 and sporadic) is:
The surgical treatment for MEN1-associated hyperparathyroidism is:
items.exp: Treatment: 3 1/2 near-total parathyroidectomy (MEN1); adenoid extension for sporadic. (Book p859)

items.q: The m/c symptom of hypercalcaemia overall is:
items.exp: Note: m/c symptom of hypercalcaemia overall = fatigue. (Book p859)

items.q: The m/c cause of death in MEN1 is:
items.exp: Enteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumour is the m/c cause of death in MEN1. (Book p859)

items.q: The enteropancreatic tumour frequency order in MEN1 is:
items.exp: Gastrinoma > insulinoma > glucagonoma > VIPoma (20–40 yrs). (Book p859)

items.q: Glucagonoma is associated with which rash?
items.exp: Glucagonoma: migratory necrolytic erythematous rash. (Book p859)

items.q: VIPoma causes the ___ syndrome (watery diarrhoea, hypochlorhydria, acidosis).
items.exp: WDHA syndrome with a normal anion gap metabolic acidosis (NAGMA). (Book p859)

items.q: Match gastrinoma features MEN1 vs sporadic — 1) MEN1 location  2) Sporadic location  3) MEN1 malignancy risk  4) Sporadic malignancy risk … A) Passaro's triangle  B) <5%  C) Duodenum  D) >50–60%
items.exp: MEN1 gastrinoma: duodenum, small multifocal, <5% malignant, IOC endoscopic US, spreads by lymph node; sporadic: Passaro's triangle, large, >50–60%, SRS scan, blood stream. (Book p859)

items.q: Match gastrinoma IOC — 1) MEN1-associated  2) Sporadic … A) Somatostatin receptor scintigraphy (SRS) scan  B) Endoscopic ultrasound
items.exp: MEN1 gastrinoma IOC = endoscopic ultrasound; sporadic = SRS scan; treatment streptozocin + octreotide vs high-dose PPI; size >2 cm → surgery. (Book p859)

items.q: The pituitary tumour of MEN1 is typically:
MEN2A is caused by mutation of the ___ gene (proto-oncogene) on chromosome 10q via point mutation.
items.exp: RET gene (proto-oncogene) mutation on Chr 10q (d/t point mutation). (Book p859)
